source: Native CodePipeline S3 polling calibration summary
reproduction_note: The retained primary run began before supplemental controls were consolidated into the script. The final script includes the separately measured identity, enablement, effective-flag, multi-source and error-projection controls; the entire consolidated sequence was not rerun.

admission.empty: ValidationException: configuration map values have minimum length 1

observations.initial_enabled: One initial execution for one source, attributed PollForSourceChanges with action name as triggerDetail; no separate CreatePipeline execution observed.
observations.initial_disabled: CreatePipeline trigger with caller ARN, real initial source VersionId binding.
observations.version_comparison: Uploading identical bytes retained ETag but changed VersionId and triggered both enabled watchers.
observations.attribution: Stage Source/action S3Input produced triggerDetail S3Input, not stage name.
observations.source_binding: GetPipelineExecution artifactRevisions and ListPipelineExecutions sourceRevisions match actual S3 PutObject/HeadObject VersionIds.
observations.disabled_change: Enabled independent control triggered while false watcher did not; reenable admitted the changed current revision.
observations.first_enable_unchanged: False-created source baseline followed by true update admitted another execution at the SAME VersionId.
observations.unchanged_enabled_update: No additional executions observed in a 90-second window; not a universal absence proof.
observations.changed_source_key: Updating polling source key to an already-existing alternate.zip admitted its existing VersionId without another upload.
observations.two_source_create: Two enabled source actions produced TWO initial executions, one attributed to each action; BOTH executions bound BOTH source revisions.
observations.initial_missing_source: Create succeeded; seven histories over 60 seconds empty while source action latestExecution reported Failed ConfigurationError, no currentRevision/actionExecutionId or stage latestExecution.
observations.denied_source: Poll failure projected action Failed PermissionError with no currentRevision/actionExecutionId; stage latestExecution preserved prior succeeded execution. Restoring access admitted the same VersionId uploaded during denial, without another upload.
observations.unrelated_key: No additional main execution observed in the 60-second unrelated-key window; bounded observation only.

documented_not_native_exercised.inactive_disable: After 30 days of no executions, polling is disabled; metadata.pollingDisabledAt reports the timestamp

limitations: AWS exact polling cadence is not established; no fixed interval inferred from observed latencies.
Short negative windows do not establish indefinite absence.
Thirty-day inactivity disabling and reactivation are not native-exercised; official documentation says no executions for 30 days and exposes metadata.pollingDisabledAt.
Effective runtime semantics were not separately isolated for TRUE/FALSE/0/space-padded true/null; their admission was measured.
One supplemental pre-update GetPipeline output was aliased and modified; the invalid output is omitted with a capture limitation, request metadata retained.
Supplemental missing-create first DeletePipeline empty-body response was not retained due to decoder error; subsequent GetPipeline PipelineNotFoundException proves deletion.
cleanup: Primary: three pipelines deleted/GetPipelineNotFound; every owned S3 version/delete marker removed, bucket deleted/HeadBucket404; IAM inline policy and role deleted/GetRoleNoSuchEntity. Transient missing, enable, four sequential flag and multi-source pipelines deleted/GetPipelineNotFound. No credentials retained.
